reason: I forget pills at home and travel a lot, so a sachet I can toss in my bag is the first version of this that fits how I live. At $24.99 for one box I'll try it, but only one.
objection: A drawer full of half-used bottles says I quit supplements after a few weeks, and 30 foil sachets is more trash for something I might not finish. The guarantee only works if I take all 30, so it doesn't cover me quitting.
